description: Land Acquisition  - Siyambalagaswewa, Angunukolapelessa D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, detailing the government's intention to acquire specific plots of land for public purpose. The entire document provides detailed descriptions of numerous land lots (including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents), making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
